defmodule JAIDE.Manager do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @moduledoc """
  JAIDE Actor Manager for distributed task orchestration in the polyglot runtime.
  Handles task queuing, worker assignment, and load balancing across Elixir, Pony, and other actors.
  """

  defstruct [
    :workers,
    :task_queue,
    :idle_workers,
    :completed_tasks,
    :metrics,
    :config
  ]

  @type state :: %__MODULE__{
          workers: %{atom() => pid()},
          task_queue: :queue.queue(any()),
          idle_workers: [atom()],
          completed_tasks: integer(),
          metrics: %{atom() => float()},
          config: map()
        }

  @doc """
  Starts the JAIDE Manager GenServer.
  """
  @spec start_link(map()) :: GenServer.on_start()
  def start_link(config \\ %{}) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, config, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @doc """
  Submits a new task to the manager.
  """
  @spec submit_task(any()) :: :ok
  def submit_task(task) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:new_task, task})
  end

  @doc """
  Retrieves current metrics.
  """
  @spec get_metrics() :: map()
  def get_metrics() do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_metrics)
  end

  @doc """
  Scales the number of workers dynamically.
  """
  @spec scale_workers(integer()) :: :ok
  def scale_workers(num) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:scale_workers, num})
  end

  @impl true
  def init(config) do
    Logger.info("JAIDE Manager initializing with config: #{inspect(config)}")
    num_workers = config[:num_workers] || System.schedulers_online() * 2
    workers = start_workers(num_workers)
    state = %__MODULE__{
      workers: workers,
      task_queue: :queue.new(),
      idle_workers: Map.keys(workers) |> Enum.shuffle(),
      completed_tasks: 0,
      metrics: %{queue_length: 0.0, avg_completion_time: 0.0},
      config: config
    }
    schedule_metrics_update(state)
    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:new_task, task}, state) do
    new_queue = :queue.in({task, System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}, state.task_queue)
    new_state = %{state | task_queue: new_queue}
    dispatch_tasks(new_state)
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:scale_workers, num}, state) do
    current_num = map_size(state.workers)
    diff = num - current_num
    new_workers =
      if diff > 0 do
        for i <- 1..diff, reduce: state.workers do
          acc -> Map.put(acc, String.to_atom("worker_#{System.unique_integer([:monotonic])}), start_worker(i + current_num))
        end
      else
        Enum.take_random(Map.keys(state.workers), abs(diff)) |> Enum.reduce(state.workers, fn k, acc -> Map.delete(acc, k) end)
      end
    new_idle = state.idle_workers -- (Map.keys(new_workers) -- Map.keys(state.workers))
    new_state = %{state | workers: new_workers, idle_workers: new_idle}
    dispatch_tasks(new_state)
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:worker_ready, worker_pid}, state) do
    worker_id = Enum.find_key(state.workers, fn _id, pid -> pid == worker_pid end)
    new_idle = [worker_id | state.idle_workers] |> Enum.uniq()
    dispatch_tasks(%{state | idle_workers: new_idle})
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:task_complete, worker_pid, result, start_time}, state) do
    completion_time = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - start_time
    worker_id = Enum.find_key(state.workers, fn _id, pid -> pid == worker_pid end)
    new_idle = [worker_id | state.idle_workers] |> Enum.uniq()
    new_completed = state.completed_tasks + 1
    new_metrics = update_metrics(state.metrics, completion_time, :queue.len(state.task_queue))
    Logger.info("Task completed by #{inspect(worker_pid)} in #{completion_time}ms. Total completed: #{new_completed}")
    new_state = %{state | idle_workers: new_idle, completed_tasks: new_completed, metrics: new_metrics}
    dispatch_tasks(new_state)
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_metrics, _from, state) do
    {:reply, state.metrics, state}
  end

  defp dispatch_tasks(state) do
    case {state.idle_workers, :queue.out(state.task_queue)} do
      {[], _} ->
        {:noreply, state}

      {_, {:empty, _}} ->
        {:noreply, state}

      {[worker_id | rest_idle], {{:value, {task, start_time}}, new_queue}} ->
        worker_pid = state.workers[worker_id]
        JAIDE.Worker.assign_task(worker_pid, task, start_time)
        new_metrics = update_metrics(state.metrics, 0, :queue.len(new_queue))
        new_state = %{state | task_queue: new_queue, idle_workers: rest_idle, metrics: new_metrics}
        dispatch_tasks(new_state)

      _ ->
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  defp start_workers(num) do
    for i <- 1..num, reduce: %{} do
      acc ->
        {:ok, pid} = JAIDE.Worker.start_link(i)
        worker_id = String.to_atom("worker_#{i}")
        Map.put(acc, worker_id, pid)
    end
  end

  defp start_worker(id) do
    {:ok, pid} = JAIDE.Worker.start_link(id)
    pid
  end

  defp update_metrics(metrics, completion_time, queue_len) do
    new_avg_time = if metrics.avg_completion_time == 0 do completion_time else (metrics.avg_completion_time * (metrics[:task_count] || 0) + completion_time) / (metrics[:task_count] || 1 + 1) end
    metrics
    |> Map.put(:avg_completion_time, new_avg_time)
    |> Map.put(:queue_length, queue_len)
    |> Map.put(:task_count, (metrics[:task_count] || 0) + 1)
  end

  defp schedule_metrics_update(state) do
    Process.send_after(self(), :update_metrics, 5000)
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:update_metrics, state) do
    # Log or send metrics to external system
    Logger.info("Metrics: #{inspect(state.metrics)}")
    schedule_metrics_update(state)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  # Fault tolerance
  @impl true
  def handle_info({:DOWN, _ref, :process, pid, _reason}, state) do
    worker_id = Enum.find_key(state.workers, fn _id, w_pid -> w_pid == pid end)
    if worker_id do
      new_workers = Map.delete(state.workers, worker_id)
      new_idle = List.delete(state.idle_workers, worker_id)
      Logger.warn("Worker #{worker_id} down. Restarting.")
      {:ok, new_pid} = JAIDE.Worker.start_link(System.unique_integer([:monotonic]))
      new_state = %{state | workers: Map.put(new_workers, worker_id, new_pid), idle_workers: new_idle}
      dispatch_tasks(new_state)
    end
    {:noreply, state}
  end
end

defmodule JAIDE.Worker do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @moduledoc """
  JAIDE Worker GenServer for executing compute-intensive tasks like tensor operations or quantum simulations.
  """

  defstruct [:id, :status, :current_task, :metrics]

  @type state :: %__MODULE__{
          id: integer(),
          status: :idle | :busy,
          current_task: any(),
          metrics: %{atom() => float()}
        }

  @doc """
  Starts a worker.
  """
  @spec start_link(integer()) :: GenServer.on_start()
  def start_link(id) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, id, name: via_tuple(id))
  end

  @doc """
  Assigns a task to the worker.
  """
  @spec assign_task(pid(), any(), integer()) :: :ok
  def assign_task(pid, task, start_time) do
    GenServer.cast(pid, {:run_task, task, start_time})
  end

  defp via_tuple(id), do: {:via, Registry, {JAIDE.Registry, id}}

  @impl true
  def init(id) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    Registry.register(JAIDE.Registry, id, :worker)
    Logger.info("Worker #{id} started and ready.")
    send(JAIDE.Manager, {:worker_ready, self()})
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{id: id, status: :idle, metrics: %{tasks_completed: 0, avg_time: 0.0}}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:run_task, task, start_time}, state) do
    spawn_link(fn ->
      result = execute_task(task)
      send(JAIDE.Manager, {:task_complete, self(), result, start_time})
    end)
    {:noreply, %{state | status: :busy, current_task: task}}
  end

  defp execute_task(task) do
    # Simulate heavy computation: tensor matmul, quantum sim, etc.
    :timer.sleep(Enum.random(50..500))
    # In production, call Zig FFI or Julia interop
    case task do
      {:tensor_op, op, a, b} ->
        JAIDE.TensorLib.matmul(a, b) # FFI call
      {:quantum_sim, qc} ->
        JAIDE.QuantumRunner.run(qc)
      _ ->
        "processed_#{inspect(task)}"
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:task_complete_ack, completion_time}, state) do
    new_metrics = update_worker_metrics(state.metrics, completion_time)
    Logger.debug("Worker #{state.id} metrics: #{inspect(new_metrics)}")
    send(JAIDE.Manager, {:worker_ready, self()})
    {:noreply, %{state | status: :idle, current_task: nil, metrics: new_metrics}}
  end

  defp update_worker_metrics(metrics, time) do
    count = metrics.tasks_completed + 1
    avg = if metrics.avg_time == 0, do: time, else: (metrics.avg_time * (count - 1) + time) / count
    %{metrics | tasks_completed: count, avg_time: avg}
  end

  # Error handling
  @impl true
  def handle_info({:EXIT, _pid, reason}, state) do
    Logger.error("Worker #{state.id} error: #{inspect(reason)}")
    {:stop, reason, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def terminate(reason, state) do
    Logger.warn("Worker #{state.id} terminating: #{inspect(reason)}")
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule JAIDE.Registry do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(_) do
    Registry.start_link(keys: :unique, name: JAIDE.Registry)
    {:ok, %{}}
  end
end

# Additional modules for polyglot integration
defmodule JAIDE.PonyBridge do
  @moduledoc "Bridge to Pony actors via ports or NIFs"

  def send_to_pony(actor_id, message) do
    # Port call to Pony runtime
    port = Port.open({:spawn, "pony_worker #{actor_id}"}, [:binary])
    Port.command(port, :erlang.term_to_binary(message))
    receive do
      {^port, {:data, data}} -> :erlang.binary_to_term(data)
    after
      5000 -> {:error, :timeout}
    end
  end
end

defmodule JAIDE.JuliaInterop do
  @moduledoc "Julia interop via Ports"

  def call_julia(module, function, args) do
    port = Port.open({:spawn_executable, System.find_executable("julia")}, [:binary, :nouse_stdio])
    cmd = "using #{module}; #{function}(#{Enum.join(args, ", ")})"
    Port.command(port, cmd <> "\n")
    receive do
      {^port, {:data, result}} -> String.trim(result)
    after
      10000 -> {:error, :timeout}
    end
  end
end

defmodule JAIDE.ZigFFI do
  @moduledoc "Zig FFI via NIFs or ports"

  @on_load :load_nif

  def load_nif do
    case :erlang.load_nif("./libjaide_v35.so", 0) do
      :ok -> :ok
      {:error, {:load_failed, reason}} -> Logger.error("NIF load failed: #{reason}")
    end
  end

  def nif_matmul(a_ptr, b_ptr, c_ptr) do
    # Native call stub
    :erlang.nif_error(:nif_not_loaded)
  end
end

# Application supervisor
defmodule JAIDE.Application do
  use Application

  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      JAIDE.Registry,
      {JAIDE.Manager, %{num_workers: 16}}
    ]
    opts = [strategy: :one_for_all, name: JAIDE.Supervisor]
    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
  end
end

    :config
  ]

  @type state :: %__MODULE__{
          workers: %{atom() => pid()},
          task_queue: :queue.queue(any()),
          idle_workers: [atom()],
          completed_tasks: non_neg_integer(),
          metrics: map(),
          config: map()
        }

  @spec start_link(map()) :: GenServer.on_start()
  def start_link(config \\ %{}) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, config, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @spec submit_task(any()) :: :ok
  def submit_task(task) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:new_task, task})
  end

  @spec get_metrics() :: map()
  def get_metrics() do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_metrics)
  end

  @spec scale_workers(integer()) :: :ok
  def scale_workers(num) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:scale_workers, num})
  end

  @impl true
  def init(config) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    Logger.info("JAIDE Manager initializing with config: #{inspect(config)}")
    num_workers = config[:num_workers] || System.schedulers_online() * 2
    workers = start_workers(num_workers)
    state = %__MODULE__{
      workers: workers,
      task_queue: :queue.new(),
      idle_workers: Map.keys(workers) |> Enum.shuffle(),
      completed_tasks: 0,
      metrics: %{queue_length: 0, avg_completion_time: 0.0, task_count: 0},
      config: config
    }
    schedule_metrics_update()
    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:new_task, task}, state) do
    new_queue = :queue.in({task, System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}, state.task_queue)
    new_state = %{state | task_queue: new_queue}
    dispatch_tasks(new_state)
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:scale_workers, num}, state) do
    current_num = map_size(state.workers)
    diff = num - current_num

    cond do
      diff > 0 ->
        new_entries =
          for _ <- 1..diff do
            id = System.unique_integer([:monotonic])
            key = String.to_atom("worker_#{id}")
            pid = start_worker(id)
            {key, pid}
          end

        new_workers = Map.merge(state.workers, Map.new(new_entries))
        new_idle = state.idle_workers ++ Enum.map(new_entries, fn {k, _} -> k end)
        new_state = %{state | workers: new_workers, idle_workers: new_idle}
        dispatch_tasks(new_state)

      diff < 0 ->
        to_remove =
          state.workers
          |> Map.keys()
          |> Enum.shuffle()
          |> Enum.take(abs(diff))

        Enum.each(to_remove, fn key ->
          if pid = state.workers[key] do
            Process.exit(pid, :normal)
          end
        end)

        new_workers = Map.drop(state.workers, to_remove)
        new_idle = Enum.filter(state.idle_workers, fn k -> Map.has_key?(new_workers, k) end)
        new_state = %{state | workers: new_workers, idle_workers: new_idle}
        dispatch_tasks(new_state)

      true ->
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:worker_ready, worker_pid}, state) do
    worker_id =
      Enum.find_value(state.workers, fn {id, pid} ->
        if pid == worker_pid, do: id, else: nil
      end)

    case worker_id do
      nil ->
        {:noreply, state}

      id ->
        new_idle = [id | state.idle_workers] |> Enum.uniq()
        dispatch_tasks(%{state | idle_workers: new_idle})
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:task_complete, worker_pid, _result, start_time}, state) do
    completion_time = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - start_time

    worker_id =
      Enum.find_value(state.workers, fn {id, pid} ->
        if pid == worker_pid, do: id, else: nil
      end)

    if worker_id do
      send(worker_pid, {:task_complete_ack, completion_time})
    end

    new_idle =
      case worker_id do
        nil -> state.idle_workers
        id -> [id | state.idle_workers] |> Enum.uniq()
      end

    new_completed = state.completed_tasks + 1
    new_metrics = update_metrics(state.metrics, completion_time, :queue.len(state.task_queue))
    Logger.info("Task completed by #{inspect(worker_pid)} in #{completion_time}ms. Total completed: #{new_completed}")
    new_state = %{state | idle_workers: new_idle, completed_tasks: new_completed, metrics: new_metrics}
    dispatch_tasks(new_state)
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:update_metrics, state) do
    Logger.info("Metrics: #{inspect(state.metrics)}")
    schedule_metrics_update()
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:EXIT, pid, reason}, state) do
    worker_id =
      Enum.find_value(state.workers, fn {id, w_pid} ->
        if w_pid == pid, do: id, else: nil
      end)

    cond do
      is_nil(worker_id) ->
        {:noreply, state}

      reason in [:normal, :shutdown] ->
        new_workers = Map.delete(state.workers, worker_id)
        new_idle = List.delete(state.idle_workers, worker_id)
        {:noreply, %{state | workers: new_workers, idle_workers: new_idle}}

      true ->
        Logger.warn("Worker #{worker_id} down with reason #{inspect(reason)}. Restarting.")
        id = System.unique_integer([:monotonic])
        {:ok, new_pid} = JAIDE.Worker.start_link(id)
        new_workers = Map.put(state.workers, worker_id, new_pid)
        new_idle = [worker_id | List.delete(state.idle_workers, worker_id)] |> Enum.uniq()
        dispatch_tasks(%{state | workers: new_workers, idle_workers: new_idle})
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_metrics, _from, state) do
    {:reply, state.metrics, state}
  end

  defp dispatch_tasks(state) do
    case {state.idle_workers, :queue.out(state.task_queue)} do
      {[], _} ->
        {:noreply, state}

      {_, {:empty, _}} ->
        {:noreply, state}

      {[worker_id | rest_idle], {{:value, {task, start_time}}, new_queue}} ->
        worker_pid = state.workers[worker_id]

        if is_pid(worker_pid) and Process.alive?(worker_pid) do
          JAIDE.Worker.assign_task(worker_pid, task, start_time)
          new_metrics = update_metrics(state.metrics, 0, :queue.len(new_queue))
          new_state = %{state | task_queue: new_queue, idle_workers: rest_idle, metrics: new_metrics}
          dispatch_tasks(new_state)
        else
          new_state = %{state | idle_workers: rest_idle}
          dispatch_tasks(new_state)
        end

      _ ->
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  defp start_workers(num) do
    for i <- 1..num, reduce: %{} do
      acc ->
        {:ok, pid} = JAIDE.Worker.start_link(i)
        worker_id = String.to_atom("worker_#{i}")
        Map.put(acc, worker_id, pid)
    end
  end

  defp start_worker(id) do
    {:ok, pid} = JAIDE.Worker.start_link(id)
    pid
  end

  defp update_metrics(metrics, completion_time, queue_len) do
    metrics =
      if completion_time > 0 do
        count = metrics[:task_count] || 0
        avg = metrics[:avg_completion_time] || 0.0
        new_count = count + 1

        new_avg =
          if count == 0 do
            completion_time * 1.0
          else
            avg + (completion_time - avg) / new_count
          end

        metrics
        |> Map.put(:avg_completion_time, new_avg)
        |> Map.put(:task_count, new_count)
      else
        metrics
      end

    Map.put(metrics, :queue_length, queue_len)
  end

  defp schedule_metrics_update() do
    Process.send_after(self(), :update_metrics, 5000)
  end
end

defmodule JAIDE.Worker do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  defstruct [:id, :status, :current_task, :metrics]

  @type state :: %__MODULE__{
          id: integer(),
          status: :idle | :busy,
          current_task: any(),
          metrics: %{atom() => number()}
        }

  @spec start_link(integer()) :: GenServer.on_start()
  def start_link(id) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, id, name: via_tuple(id))
  end

  @spec assign_task(pid(), any(), integer()) :: :ok
  def assign_task(pid, task, start_time) do
    GenServer.cast(pid, {:run_task, task, start_time})
  end

  defp via_tuple(id), do: {:via, Registry, {JAIDE.Registry, id}}

  @impl true
  def init(id) do
    Logger.info("Worker #{id} started and ready.")
    send(JAIDE.Manager, {:worker_ready, self()})
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{id: id, status: :idle, current_task: nil, metrics: %{tasks_completed: 0, avg_time: 0.0}}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:run_task, task, start_time}, state) do
    spawn(fn ->
      result = execute_task(task)
      send(JAIDE.Manager, {:task_complete, self(), result, start_time})
    end)

    {:noreply, %{state | status: :busy, current_task: task}}
  end

  defp execute_task(task) do
    :timer.sleep(Enum.random(50..500))

    case task do
      {:quantum_sim, qc} ->
        JAIDE.QuantumRunner.run(qc)

      _ ->
        "processed_#{inspect(task)}"
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:task_complete_ack, completion_time}, state) do
    new_metrics = update_worker_metrics(state.metrics, completion_time)
    Logger.debug("Worker #{state.id} metrics: #{inspect(new_metrics)}")
    send(JAIDE.Manager, {:worker_ready, self()})
    {:noreply, %{state | status: :idle, current_task: nil, metrics: new_metrics}}
  end

  defp update_worker_metrics(metrics, time) do
    count = (metrics[:tasks_completed] || 0) + 1
    avg_prev = metrics[:avg_time] || 0.0
    avg = if count == 1, do: time * 1.0, else: avg_prev + (time - avg_prev) / count
    %{metrics | tasks_completed: count, avg_time: avg}
  end
end

defmodule JAIDE.PonyBridge do
  def send_to_pony(actor_id, message) do
    port = Port.open({:spawn, "pony_worker #{actor_id}"}, [:binary, :exit_status])
    Port.command(port, :erlang.term_to_binary(message))

    receive do
      {^port, {:data, data}} -> :erlang.binary_to_term(data)
      {^port, {:exit_status, status}} -> {:error, {:exit_status, status}}
    after
      5000 -> {:error, :timeout}
    end
  end
end

defmodule JAIDE.JuliaInterop do
  def call_julia(module, function, args) do
    exec = System.find_executable("julia")
    if is_nil(exec), do: {:error, :julia_not_found}, else: nil
    port = Port.open({:spawn_executable, exec}, [:binary, :use_stdio, :exit_status, args: []])
    cmd = "using #{module}; #{function}(#{Enum.map(args, &inspect/1) |> Enum.join(", ")})\n"
    Port.command(port, cmd)

    receive do
      {^port, {:data, result}} ->
        String.trim(result)

      {^port, {:exit_status, status}} ->
        {:error, {:exit_status, status}}
    after
      10000 ->
        {:error, :timeout}
    end
  end
end
